title: Fermi scale from quantum gravity scaling solution
summary: We propose that quantum gravity may predict the Fermi scale. Fundamental scale invariance implies the scale invariant standard model. Both the Fermi scale and the Planck mass are given by fields, and their ratio is dictated by a dimensionless cosmon-Higgs coupling. For an ultraviolet fixed point of quantum gravity this coupling is an irrelevant parameter of the renormalization flow and becomes predictable.
